title: ship config
description: Configuration for the ship CLI. Lives in the root of the git repository as ship.config.json.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, so editors can validate the file.

deploy.description: Shell command that deploys each environment. Commands run with sh from the repository root, and a non-zero exit counts as a failed deploy.

dev.description: Deploys the checked-out ship/ or hotfix/ branch to dev.

staging.description: Deploys the rebuilt staging branch: latest main plus every feature on staging.

prod.description: Deploys main, with the feature or hotfix squash-merged onto it, to production.
